sentences.text: Judgment

The above Writ Petition (C) is filed with the following prayers:
"(i) call for the records leading up to and including Exhibit P5 and P7 (ii) Issue a writ of certiorari quashing Exhibit P5 and P7 and all proceedings pursuant there to (iii) To issue a writ in the nature of a declaration that no prosecution can be initiated against the petitioner based on Exhibit P4 reports in the light of the decisions Exhibits P6 and P8.

(iv) issue an appropriate direction to the respondents not interfere in any manner with the manufacture, sale and such business of Coconut Testa oil based on the analysis report Exhibit P4 here after.
(v) issue a writ order or direction directing the second respondent to enforce Exhibit P9 strictly.
(vi) dispense with the production of English translation of the Exhibits in vernacular language.

(vii) issue an appropriate writ, order or direction including interim orders as that are necessary in the circumstances of the case and allow this Writ Petition with costs."

sentences.text: The petitioner is aggrieved by Ext.P7 adjudication notice issued by the 4th respondent.
3. I am not inclined to entertain this Writ Petition.

At this WP(C) NO.1563 OF 2026 2026:KER:14702 stage, the counsel appearing for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner may be allowed to submit his objection to Ext.P7 and there may be a direction to consider the same.
I think that prayer can be allowed.

Therefore, this Writ Petition is disposed of in the following manner:
1. The petitioner is free to submit his objection to Ext.P7, within two weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
2.

If such an objection is received, the competent authority will consider the same and pass appropriate orders in accordance with the law, as expeditiously as possible,
at any rate, within a period of one month from the date of receipt of the objection.

3. Till final orders are passed in the objection, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner based on Ext.P7.
